text: In accordance with city-wide residential demolition control under Article II, Demolition Control, of Municipal Code Ch. 363, as amended by By-law No. 1009-2006, enacted by City Council on September 27, 2006 under the authority of Section 33 of the Planning Act, I refer the demolition application for 195 Silver Birch Avenue (Application No. 18-134815 DEM 00 DM) to Toronto and East York Community Council for consideration and to decide whether to grant or refuse the application, including any conditions, if any, to be attached to the permit application. This staff report is regarding a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the application to demolish the subject detached single family dwelling at 195 Silver Birch Avenue as a replacement building permit has been issued and the following conditions are imposed on the demolition permit: a. Completion of the new replacement building is within 2 years from the start of the demolition of the subject existing detached single family dwelling; b. Failure to complete the new replacement building within the 2 year time period from the start of the demolition of the subject existing detached single family dwelling, the City is entitled to add to the municipal taxes of the property an amount of $20,000; and c. Any further condition(s), that in the opinion of the Toronto East York Community Council is reasonable, having regard to the nature of the residential property to be demolished.
